negative_action: Rigid adherence to protocol or technique
description: Strictly following standardized procedures or one framework without adapting to patient context.
risk: Reduces effectiveness, may harm alliance, alienates or overwhelms patient.

negative_action: Ignoring or undermining therapeutic alliance
description: Neglecting collaborative relationship or empathy with the patient.
risk: Damages trust, reduces engagement and effectiveness.

negative_action: Forcing interventions or exposure before readiness
description: Pushing patients into experiments, exposure tasks, or new skills before consent or preparation.
risk: Causes distress, loss of trust, increases dropout and risk of harm.

negative_action: Dismissing, minimizing, or invalidating patient thoughts or emotions
description: Ignoring, downplaying, or criticizing patient emotional experiences or distress.
risk: Breaks trust and may worsen distress or lead to dropout.

negative_action: Allowing or reinforcing avoidance and safety behaviors
description: Permitting use of distraction, rituals, reassurance, or safety strategies during exposure or therapy.
risk: Maintains anxiety and maladaptive patterns, undermines therapeutic progress.

negative_action: Making uncollaborative assumptions about patient beliefs or readiness
description: Assuming patient beliefs or history without collaborative exploration.
risk: Leads to resistance, misunderstanding, reduced efficacy.

negative_action: Skipping planning, preparation, or debriefing for experiments
description: Failing to plan, reflect, or provide preparation and follow-up for behavioral or cognitive tasks.
risk: Limits learning, may increase distress, reduces quality of outcomes.

negative_action: Breaching confidentiality or professional boundaries
description: Disregarding privacy or ethical boundaries or sharing patient information inappropriately.
risk: Damages trust, alliance, and may have legal repercussions.

negative_action: Neglecting physical health or medical safety
description: Ignoring health risks, needed clearance, or safety in interventions; offering advice outside professional scope.
risk: Endangers patient, can result in harm or legal issues.

negative_action: Overwhelming the patient with excessive, complex, or unrealistic tasks
description: Assigning tasks or goals that are too difficult, packed, vague, or mismatched with patient readiness.
risk: Causes discouragement, avoidance, disengagement.

negative_action: Offering non-evidence-based or unproven interventions
description: Using untested, anecdotal, or outdated methods not supported by empirical research.
risk: Ineffective or harmful therapy outcomes.

negative_action: Invalidating accurate perceptions or real risks
description: Dismissing genuine negative events or minimizing physical, social, or emotional risks.
risk: Alienates patient, undermines safety, prevents adaptive coping.

negative_action: Focusing exclusively on cognition or behavior
description: Only targeting cognitive or behavioral aspects, neglecting emotions, context, or environmental factors.
risk: Limits efficacy and ignores core issues.

negative_action: Using authoritarian, didactic, or impersonal communication
description: Lecturing, persuading, or communicating in a top-down manner instead of guided discovery.
risk: Fosters resistance, inhibits alliance, reduces engagement.

negative_action: Assigning blame, shaming, or criticizing for symptoms or setbacks
description: Responding punitively or judgmentally to errors, failures, or lack of progress.
risk: Increases shame, undermines motivation, and engagement.

negative_action: Neglecting or improperly assessing suicide or self-harm risk
description: Failing to monitor, assess, or respond to signs of suicidality or self-harm.
risk: Serious patient safety threat, potential loss of life.

negative_action: Ignoring comorbid conditions or contextual factors
description: Neglecting physical health, substance use, trauma, or cultural/social background in treatment.
risk: Poor outcomes, alienates patient, misses core contributors.

negative_action: Proceeding before medical or psychiatric stabilization
description: Starting therapy with acute medical or psychiatric instability.
risk: Worsens condition or misses critical medical needs.

negative_action: Failing to track symptoms, progress, or relapse risk
description: Omitting symptom monitoring, progress tracking, or relapse prevention planning.
risk: Increases risk of deterioration and missed setbacks.

negative_action: Endorsing unrealistic expectations of rapid or total symptom elimination
description: Promising complete, instant relief from symptoms or minimizing plateaus/setbacks.
risk: Leads to disappointment, drop-out, and invalidates patient experience.

negative_action: Conflating therapist authority over patient's autonomy or physician's role
description: Imposing therapist’s views, dismissing patient agency, or contradicting medical guidance.
risk: Reduces collaboration, risks safety, erodes trust.

negative_action: Using stigmatizing language or labels
description: Labeling or pathologizing patients negatively or pejoratively.
risk: Damages self-esteem, increases stigma, blocks progress.

negative_action: Encouraging passive or superficial efforts
description: Accepting half-hearted attempts, lack of engagement, or letting patient be passive in process.
risk: Reduces skill development, fosters dependence, impairs outcomes.

negative_action: Forcing or rushing cognitive challenging or belief change
description: Challenging beliefs, guided discovery, or core schemas before rapport or readiness.
risk: Increases resistance, distress, or dropout.

negative_action: Failing to tailor interventions to individual background, history, or education
description: Using generic or irrelevant interventions that disregard patient’s history, strengths, culture, or learning style.
risk: Reduces motivation, engagement, relevance, and efficacy.

negative_action: Neglecting to explain rationale for therapy and interventions
description: Not clarifying purpose behind interventions or making process opaque.
risk: Undermines trust and collaboration.

negative_action: Endorsing avoidance, suppression, or denial of distressing emotions
description: Encouraging patient to suppress, ignore, or avoid emotional or distressing content.
risk: Blocks emotional processing and genuine healing.

negative_action: Making premature inferences or interpretations without patient input
description: Drawing conclusions about symptoms or underlying causes without collaboration or sufficient evidence.
risk: Leads to errors, reduces alliance quality.

negative_action: Using non-specific, vague, or unstructured session formats or goals
description: Skipping agenda-setting or using unclear/unrealistic goal setting.
risk: Sessions become unfocused, limiting therapeutic progress.

negative_action: Shaming or blaming for ineffective coping attempts
description: Criticizing patient for trying but failing to implement helpful strategies.
risk: Increases defensiveness and disengagement.

negative_action: Neglecting supervision, reflective practice, or self-care
description: Ignoring personal burnout or failing to seek feedback or supervision.
risk: Reduces therapy quality and increases risk of error.

negative_action: Practicing outside scope of competence
description: Treating cases beyond professional expertise or legal authority.
risk: Risks patient safety, legal consequences, and ineffective treatment.

negative_action: Proceeding with advanced interventions or schema work before basic skills are established
description: Attempting complex treatments or cognitive restructuring prematurely.
risk: Patient may disengage or not benefit from therapy.

negative_action: Rushing assessment or pressing for full disclosure early
description: Hurrying intake or pushing patients for personal revelations prematurely.
risk: Increases patient anxiety and diminishes engagement.

negative_action: Combining medication and CBT without coordination
description: Implementing both therapies without clarifying roles, rationale, or monitoring effects.
risk: Confusion regarding treatment impact and reduced efficacy.

negative_action: Encouraging excessive self-blame or guilt
description: Promoting harsh internal dialogue or shame during cognitive restructuring.
risk: Undermines healing and increases depressive symptoms.

negative_action: Promoting unreliable or anecdotal information
description: Endorsing non-evidence-based approaches or unverified advice.
risk: Risks ineffective or harmful outcomes.

negative_action: Minimizing positive feedback, strengths, or small improvements
description: Only emphasizing problems, ignoring growth and achievement.
risk: Decreases motivation and self-efficacy.
